name: Ryohei Yukino
source:
A well-mannered student. Ryohei, attends Morning Glory Academy and feels an unspoken bond or connection with Suiko. Athletic, studious, and kindhearted, Ryohei is the prime example of what every student strives to be. His favorite sport is baseball and can be found practicing after school.

[From Kickstarter]
